# Marbella Boat Charter

Marbella Boat Charter is a yacht and boat charter company based in Puerto Banús, Marbella, Spain, serving the Costa del Sol.

Canonical site: https://marbellaboatcharter.com/
Phone: +34 682 25 25 26
Email: info@marbellaboatcharter.com
Address: Edificio de Levante 10-B, 29660 Puerto Banús

## Core services
- Private motor yacht charter
- Sailing yacht and catamaran charter
- Fishing charters
- Group and corporate boat events
- Yacht management and maintenance
- Yacht catering and event extras

## Operating geography
Puerto Banús is the main base for many private yacht departures. Depending on vessel and programme, service also covers Marbella, Estepona and Sotogrande, with longer itineraries toward Gibraltar and selected Morocco routes.

## Booking facts
Published booking terms require a 50% deposit to confirm and the remaining 50% seven days before charter. Weather cancellations are eligible for a complete refund under the published terms. Vessel pricing and inclusions vary; the final quotation controls.
